title: Weldlibanos, Hauger-Thackery Win Rainy Honolulu
excerpt: Tsegay Weldlibanos (2:13:38) and Calli Hauger-Thackery (2:30:43) won a rainy 2025 Honolulu Marathon. How to race well when conditions are bad.
body:
The 2025 JAL Honolulu Marathon on December 14 was run in wet, humid conditions after an early downpour. Eritrea's Tsegay Weldlibanos won the men's race in 2:13:38, and Calli Hauger-Thackery won the women's race in 2:30:43, the first British woman to win in Honolulu. Both were first-time winners.

Most runners race in rain, wind or heat more often than in perfect weather. In those conditions, a time goal set for an ideal day stops being useful. Racing well means adjusting to the conditions: running by effort, starting more conservatively and focusing on your position against other runners.

Next time you race in bad weather, treat it as its own category of performance. Measure yourself against the conditions and the field, not the clock.

Sources: LetsRun.com; Running USA
keyTakeaway: In bad conditions, race by effort and judge yourself against the conditions, not the clock.
